notices.text:
As the rain has stopped earlier than initially forecast and wind conditions are improving, we inform you that the following areas will REOPEN tomorrow morning, Friday 13th November:

MANIE AREA***
SAN BERNARDINO AREA***
CAPRAZOPPA AREA***
MONTE GROSSO AREA***
RANZI AREA

*********************************************************************************************************************************

We also inform you that the following areas will REOPEN from 1:00 pm:

SPOTORNO AREA***
* VADO LIGURE AREA – except for trail 602 Roaldo

*********************************************************************************************************************************

During the morning, we will assess the weather conditions and, in consultation with the Local Municipalities, decide whether any other areas can reopen in the afternoon.
